name: Warbands of Trench Crusade
_note: What the BOOK states and the catalogues lack. Nothing here is a change to a published value: it is the printed entry reaching a field the catalogue left empty, or carrying a name the catalogue never caught up with.

Applied BEFORE dispatch-01, so the Dispatch still wins wherever the two speak about the same thing. `data-sources/resolutions.json` states the precedence as Dispatch over rulebook over catalogue; the rulebook rung had no layer until this one.
Every op addresses its target BY ID. Two units are named 'Combat Medic' and the Mercenaries one is the Sister of Saint Cosmas; the layer engine refuses an ambiguous name outright.
Every value is transcribed from the cited lines and `layers.transcription.test.mjs` checks each one against the extract, so a line that drifts fails the suite rather than shipping.

ops._why: The catalogue kept the model's pre-rename name, 'Combat Medic', which is also the name of a New Antioch Troop. `entryName` keeps the catalogue's spelling for promotions, and a saved roster keeps its snapshot name and its stable id.
ops._src: warbands-of-trench-crusade.txt L10366 — '0-1 Sister of Saint Cosmas - Cost: 2 ☼'

ops._why: The catalogue carries a bare '0'. The book prints '+0 DICE', which is the same value written the way every other statline is.

ops.name: Finish the Fallen

ability.name: Finish the Fallen
ability.description: Due to their knowledge of anatomy and physiology, the Sisters are experts at inflicting debilitating injuries and excruciating pain. Add +1 INJURY DICE to Injury Rolls for Melee Attacks made by a Sister of Saint Cosmas if the target is Down and does not have the BLACK GRAIL or DEMONIC Keywords.

ops._why: The catalogue's text says '+1 DICE' where the book says '+1 INJURY DICE'. Those are different rolls.

ops.value: A Sister of Saint Cosmas always has Standard Armour, a Gas Mask, Medi-kit and a Misericordia.

ability.name: Battlefield Vivisection
ability.description: Whenever a Combat Biologist is part of your Warband, add the Gather Knowledge Glorious Deed to those normally available in each scenario you play.

grantsDeed.name: Gather Knowledge
grantsDeed.description: You complete this Glorious Deed if 3 or more enemy models are taken Out of Action while they are within 1” of a friendly Combat Biologist.

ops._why: The catalogue gives the Combat Biologist no abilities at all. `grantsDeed` is what puts Gather Knowledge in Play Mode's deed list when a Biologist is on the roster, which is what the ability says happens.
ops._src: warbands-of-trench-crusade.txt L9804-9806, the deed at L9807-9809

ability.name: Prize Specimens
ability.description: When a Combat Biologist takes any enemy model with the Keyword DEMONIC or BLACK GRAIL Out of Action with a Melee attack, place 1 BLESSING MARKER beside the Combat Biologist.

ops.value: A Combat Biologist always has Gas Grenades, Standard Armour, a Gas Mask, and a Vivisector (▶ see Vivisector).

ops._why: The Vivisector is a Weapon profile on the model itself. The parser will not read that shape as forced kit, because the catalogue also uses it for reference statlines and doing so gives the Artillery Witch two bombs the book never grants her (see `forcedKitOf`). The book says the Biologist always has one, so the book is what says it here.
ops._src: warbands-of-trench-crusade.txt L9802-9803 — 'always has Gas Grenades, Standard Armour, a Gas Mask, and a Vivisector'

ops._why: Stated by alignment, not by a list of names. Writing the Fallen factions out here would go stale the moment a Fallen Warband is added — which is how the Heretic Naval Raiders came to be missed by hand-written host lists. `recruitable.ts` resolves it against each faction's own alignment.
ops._src: warbands-of-trench-crusade.txt L10273 — 'A Sin Eater is Fallen and can be recruited as a Mercenary by Fallen Warbands.'

ops._why: The Sister's keyword list was EMPTY — the catalogue gives her none at all — so she was the one model in the game with no keywords, and NEGATE FEAR was simply not being applied.

She had NO host restriction, so all six Warbands were offered her. The book names one. Stated as a faction rather than as an alignment because the book names the Warband, and the Carcass Front delegation — the Procession takes what Trench Pilgrims take — extends a named list and would not see an alignment.
ops._src: warbands-of-trench-crusade.txt L10367-10368 — 'A Sister of Saint Cosmas is Faithful and can be recruited as a Mercenary by Trench Pilgrim Warbands.'
